plays.description: On second-and-inches, Prescott rolls and throws; the captions cut away before identifying the target or result.
Commentary describes Prescott hitting Pickens downfield after improvising inside the pocket. No yardage is supplied.
Prescott is intercepted by Brandon Cisse after intended receiver CeeDee Lamb falls down. Cisse returns the interception 5 yards.
On third-and-8, Joey Porter Jr. is flagged for defensive pass interference on Love's deep right target to Melton. The DB records a 37-yard penalty and no play.
Love escapes the pocket on third-and-6. The target and result are missing; a match to Golden's subsequent 21-yard reception cannot be established confidently.
Love sneaks over the goal line for a 1-yard touchdown. Replay commentary describes the offensive line moving Kenny Clark backward.
A third-and-9 play is followed by references to the first-down marker and Prescott's leadership. The action and result are too incomplete to establish a conversion.
Williams scores a 1-yard rushing touchdown. Commentary identifies an extra eligible lineman and Brevyn Spann-Ford serving as fullback.

Replay commentary describes an unnamed Dallas edge rusher getting fingers on Love's throw while standing in the end zone. The final result is unspecified.
Prescott completes a third-and-6 pass to an unnamed receiver. Commentary immediately identifies slants as available against Green Bay's blitz looks, but the captions do not establish the gain.

plays.description: Love gets the ball to Golden before being hit by C. Downs. The DB identifies a 21-yard reception to the right, ending out of bounds.

plays.description: Prescott throws quickly to Pickens, who attempts to evade defenders with CeeDee Lamb nearby. The gain is missing.
Carrington Valentine intercepts a pass intended for Jonathan Mingo and returns it 21 yards, but Lukas Van Ness's roughing-the-passer penalty nullifies the play.

plays.description: Dallas faces fourth-and-11 with Green Bay showing pressure. The captions omit the action and outcome.
Prescott slips at the top of his drop, then completes a 6-yard touchdown to Flournoy. Commentary describes an unidentified defender being knocked backward on the route.
Dallas attempts two to make it a one-score game. The DB supplies the outcome: Prescott's pass to CeeDee Lamb is incomplete; offensive holding is declined.

Commentary identifies slants as available against Green Bay's blitz looks near the 11:42 completion.
Flournoy supplied a first-down reception with a broken tackle and the late receiving touchdown.

Porter Jr.'s 37-yard pass-interference penalty extended Green Bay's late-first-half possession.
The defensive front yielded Love's 1-yard sneak touchdown; commentary specifically describes Clark being moved backward.

The offensive line generated movement on Love's touchdown sneak.

Dallas finished its third-quarter drive with Williams's touchdown behind an extra lineman and fullback.

Flournoy escaped a tackle on a first-down catch and later scored against an unidentified defender.

limitations: Captions are fragmented and provide no visual evidence. Several entries identify only partial actions or pre-snap situations; these are explicitly marked. Formation and coverage details are included only when spoken, with tentative calls preserved as tentative. Named tacklers do not establish who lost coverage. Interception yards follow DB return yardage; the nullified Valentine return has null yards. No caption segment confidently establishes either Watson gain, Golden's 21-yard first-half catch, Pickens's late 21-yard catch, any kickoff, or a made field goal, so those DB events are not added independently. DB-only shotgun labels are excluded from personnel_formation. Reversed and nullified touchdowns/interceptions are not counted as scores or valid turnovers.
